content: Agraw n rrusul di Urcalim
Hwan-dd yeryazen zi Yahudiyya ɣar Antiyuxiya uca bdan sseřmaden i tawmat, nnan: “Mařa war tᵉttwaxetnem ɛlaḥsab tnamit n Ccariɛa n Musa, war tzemmarem ad tᵉttwassnejmem.”
Ikkar ijj n uxarweḍ d unaqec akidsen zi ṭṭarf n Bulus d Bar-Naba. Imsar aqa Bulus d Bar-Naba, u akidsen ɛad inneɣni, ruḥen ɣar rrusul d imɣaren di Urcalim zi ssibbet n unaqec-a.
Tessqebbeḍ u tessekk i-ten tmesmunt. Nitni cuqen di marra Finiqiya d temmurt n Samarya uca xebbaren mammec tuben inni iǧan zi řegnus, ssfarḥen marra tawmat aṭṭas.
Řami iwḍen ɣar Urcalim, tareḥḥeb zzaysen tmesmunt d rrusul d imɣaren u nitni xebbaren i-ten s marra min zzaysen igga AREBBI.
Maca ca zi tebridt n Ifarisiyyen inni idewřen umnen, kkaren, nnan: “Ittxeṣṣa ad ten txetnem u ad ten umuren ad cebbaren di Ccariɛa n Musa.”
Munen rrusul d imɣaren ḥima ad mcawaren x tmesřact-a.

Awarni řami tuɣa ttqacaḥen aṭṭas, ibedd Cimɛun, inna asen: “A iryazen tawmat, kenniw tessnem belli aṭṭas zeg wami AREBBI ixḍar aqa řegnus ad sřen i wawař n Řexbar Aṣebḥan s uqemmum inu uca ad zzayes amnen.
AREBBI, wenni issnen min iǧan deg wuřawen, iched xasen am d asen iwca Arruḥ Iqeddsen am i neccin.
Netta war ittegg bu řfarz jar neccin d nitni, am issizdeg uřawen nsen s l’iman.
Iwa řexxu, mayemmi tᵉttjarrabem ɛad AREBBI u tᵉtteggem ijj n uzayřu x irawen n imeḥḍaren i war zemmaren řejdud nneɣ uřa d neccin ad t narbu?
Maca s arḍa n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ numen aqa ad neṭṭef Tudart am nitni.”
Isqar řɣaci, nitni sřan i Bar-Naba d Bulus ttɛawaden x řeɛřamat d řeɛjayeb timeqqranin i zzaysen igga AREBBI jar řegnus.
Umi qqimen sqaren, ikkar Yaɛqub, inna: “A iryazen tawmat, sřem-dd ɣari.
Cimɛun ixebbar mammec tuɣa igga AREBBI deg umezwar ḥima ad ixdar ijj n řgens zi řegnus i Yisem nnes.
Man aya ittas-dd ak-d wawařen n inabiyyen am mammec tura:
“‘Awarni man aya ad dd-ɛeqbeɣ uca ad ssbeddeɣ ɛawed Tazeddiɣt iwḍan n Dawud, u min zzayes yareddǧen ad tt ssgeɛɛdeɣ uca ad tt areqqɛeɣ ɛawed,
ḥima min iqqimen n iwdan ad arzun x SIDI, uřa d marra řegnus i xef ittwařaɣa s Yisem inu!’, ammu i iqqar SIDI wenni iggin marra aya.”
Řexdayem n AREBBI aqa ttwassnent zi řebda.
S uyenni ttwařiɣ icuwwar war nesseḍqiř ca x yinni dd-iddakkwařen ɣar AREBBI zi řegnus,
maca ad asen nari ḥima ad beɛɛden x texmuji zi tɣarṣa i l’aṣnam u x farq-ccɣeř u x jjiyfat u x idammen.
Minzi Musa tuɣa ɣares di kuř tandint imxeṭṭaben di temzidawin di řejyuř iɛdun, inni zzayes qqaren di marra ussan n ssebt.”
Tabrat ɣar tmesmunt di Antiyuxiya

Xenni ixḍaren rrusul d imɣaren, jmiɛ ak-d marra tamesmunt, iryazen zi řwesṭ nsen uca ssekken Yahuda, umi qqaren ɛawed Bar-Saba, d Sila ak-d Bulus d Bar-Naba ɣar Antiyuxiya. Iryazen-a tuɣa aten d imeqqranen jar tawmat.
Urin s ufus nsen ammu:
“Rrusul d imɣaren d tawmat. I tawmat i yeǧan di Antiyuxiya d Suriya d Kilikiya, i tawmat i yeǧan zi řegnus. Sřam xawem!

Nesřa belli ca n yinni dd-yusin zi řwesṭ nneɣ, ṣedɛen kenniw s wawařen nsen, ssenhezzen tanefsect nwem, qqaren: ‘Ittxeṣṣa ad tᵉttwaxetnem u ad tᵉṭṭfem di Ccariɛa!’, umi neccin war d asen numur s man aya.
S uya nemcawar awarni řami nmun marra, uca nfarz ca n yeryazen ḥima ad ten nessekk ɣarwem ak-d imɛizzen nneɣ Bar-Naba d Bulus.
Nitni d iryazen inni iṭṭewwɛen tudart nsen i Yisem n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Nessekk-dd akidsen Yahuda d Sila, inni kenniw i ɣa ixebbaren man aya ɛawed s uqemmum nsen.
Minzi aqa-t di řxaḍar n Arruḥ Iqeddsen u di řxaḍar nneɣ, ḥima war xawem nesseḍqiř ca sennej i timesřayin tinni labudda zzaysent,
aqa ad taggʷejem x min wehhben d taɣarṣt i l’aṣnam řa x idammen řa x jjiyfat uřa x farq-ccɣeř! Mařa teḥḍam ixef nwem zi man aya, ad teggem mliḥ. Iřim d imtiqqan di Siditneɣ.”
Inni dd-ittwassekken iwḍen ɣar Antiyuxiya uca ssmunen marra iwdan, wcin asen tabrat.
Řami tt ɣrin, farḥen nitni, ttwassfewwjen.
S wawařen aṭṭas ssjehden nitn tawmat uca ssmetnen inni iǧan ak-d Yahuda d Sila, maɣar uřa d nitni tuɣa aten d inabiyyen.
Awarni řami qqimen dinni ca n řweqt, ssqebbḍen ten wawmaten s řehna ḥima ad dd-dewřen ɣar rrusul.
Maca Sila tuɣa ixs ad iqqim dinni.
Bulus d Bar-Naba qqimen di Antiyuxiya, ssɣaran, ttbarrḥen s Wawař n AREBBI ak-d waṭṭas inneɣni.
Amsebḍi n Bulus d Barnaba
Awarni ca n wussan inna Bulus i Bar-Naba: “Ejj aneɣ ad neɛqeb ɣar tawmat di kuř tandint mani tuɣa nettbarreḥ s Wawař n AREBBI, ad nargeb mammec ɣa iffeɣ umeddur nsen.”
Bar-Naba tuɣa ixs ad kisen indeh Yuḥanna, wenni ittkennan Markus,
maca Bulus tuɣa war ixs ad t yiwi, minzi Markus ismeḥ daysen umi tuɣa aten di Pamfiliya, u minzi war kisen iruḥ.
Ikkar ijj n umcubbec d ameqqran jar asen ařami mmsebḍan ijjen x wenneɣni. Bar-Naba yiwi Markus akides uca ibeḥḥar ɣar tegzirt n Qubrus.
Maca Bulus ixḍar Sila uca iffeɣ, awarni řami sellmen t wawmaten ɣar arḍa n AREBBI.
Icuq di Suriya d Kilikiya, ittcejjaɛ timesmunin.
